experience.title: Senior Vice‑President and Chief Information Officer
responsibilities: Developed IT strategy and roadmap aligned with business goals for Goodwill’s retail, e‑commerce, employment, and mission services.

Optimized IT spend through CapEx/OpEx improvements and procurement processes.
Managed outsourcing, staff augmentation, and near‑shore sourcing to enhance service delivery.

experience.title: Manager/Senior Network Engineer, Information Technology

Managed overall network performance, availability, and architecture.

experience.title: Network Administrator

Supported web presence and performed system backups.
